server.import.file_size: The export file must be between 2 bytes and 16 MiB.
server.import.file_unreadable: The export file could not be read.
server.import.invalid_json: Invalid JSON file. Use tools/export-mybb.php instead of an SQL dump.
server.import.object_required: The export must be a JSON object in the :format format.
server.import.completed: Import complete. All imported categories remain private until an administrator reviews them.
server.import.unsupported_format: Unsupported format. A :format export is required.
server.import.invalid_source_id: source_id must be 3–64 characters long and contain only ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores or hyphens.
server.import.unsupported_version: This importer only supports exports from standard MyBB 1.8.x installations.
server.import.invalid_source_url: source_url must be an HTTP(S) address without login credentials.
server.import.invalid_table: The :table field must be a list containing no more than :limit records.
server.import.record_limit: This version of the importer supports up to 60,000 records in total.
server.import.export_size: The export exceeds the 16 MiB limit.
server.import.invalid_email: The email address for account uid=:id is invalid. Correct the source data before importing.
server.import.duplicate_email: The export contains a duplicate email address (uid=:id). Accounts are not merged automatically.
server.import.missing_parent: Category fid=:id refers to a parent that does not exist.
server.import.category_cycle: The category hierarchy contains a cycle.
server.import.missing_category: Topic tid=:id refers to a category that does not exist.
server.import.missing_topic: Post pid=:id refers to a topic that does not exist.
server.import.category_mismatch: The category and topic for post pid=:id do not match.
server.import.empty_topic: Topic tid=:id contains no published posts.
server.import.archive_limit: Archive accounts exceed the record limit for this version of the importer.
server.import.archive_email_conflict: The export contains an archive account email conflict. The import has been stopped.
server.import.invalid_omitted: The omitted field must be an object containing counts of omitted data.
server.import.warning_private: All imported categories will remain private. Only administrators and moderators will have access until the categories are reviewed.
server.import.warning_roles: MyBB groups and permissions are not mapped. Imported accounts receive the member role, never administrator or moderator privileges.
server.import.warning_unsupported: Attachments, avatars, private messages, polls, reputation, notifications, profile fields and plugin data are not transferred in this version.
server.import.warning_bbcode: The original BBCode is preserved; custom tags may require a separate converter.
server.import.warning_one_time: This is a one-time import. A changed export with the same source_id will be rejected; use a fresh test installation to try again.
server.import.warning_passwords: Accounts with an unsupported password format: :count. They will be blocked and will require a separate process to recover access.
server.import.warning_guests: Blocked archive accounts that will be created for guest post authors: :count.
server.import.warning_omitted: The exporter omitted :key records. Number of omitted records: :count.
server.import.already_imported: This export has already been imported. No duplicates were created.
server.import.source_already_used: This source_id has already been used with different content. Incremental imports are not supported; do not change source_id to bypass duplicate checks.
server.import.email_conflict: At least one email address already exists in WojteX. The import was stopped without merging accounts. Use a separate test installation or resolve the conflict before importing.
server.import.missing_author: Source account uid=:id, referenced by the content, is missing.
server.import.unpublished_content: :label: unpublished or deleted content is not supported. Generate the export with the included tool.
server.import.invalid_row: Every :table record must be an object.
server.import.invalid_string: The :field field must be valid UTF-8 text, no more than :max characters long.
server.import.confirm_private: Confirm the import into private categories and the scope of supported data.
server.import.admin_only: Only an administrator can import data.
